request.deadline: contract year 2026-2027; ongoing maintenance and user support for 52 weeks; architecture assessment by Q3 2027
deliverables: Protocol maintenance including node upgrades, wallet backend updates, hard fork readiness, and compatible releases at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork
Ecosystem expansion including Keystone and Flex hardware wallet support, CIP-30 dApp connector, and Japanese localisation
User support across GitHub, community forums, direct channels, and Japanese-language support
Security and dependency maintenance for Electron, Node.js, wallet-adjacent dependencies, reproducible Nix builds, and signed releases
Architecture assessment covering current state, options, resource estimates, and recommendation
request.recipient: Se7en Labs, Inc. via Intersect-administered treasury withdrawal and monthly disbursement controls
request.what: Daedalus Wallet Maintenance and Improvements 2026-2027 delivered by Se7en Labs, Inc.

claims.claim: Daedalus is described as Cardano's only full-node desktop wallet, running an embedded Cardano node and deriving wallet and governance data directly from the chain without third-party APIs or trusted backends.

The proposal states Daedalus has approximately 4,000 monthly active users according to opt-in telemetry, while asserting the true count is meaningfully higher because privacy-conscious users are less likely to opt in.

Se7en Labs says it assumed Daedalus responsibility under an IOG contract in January 2026 and has shipped Mithril Snapshot Bootstrap, UTxO-HD/LSM backend integration, Apple Silicon builds, a release CLI, and Nix build modernization since then.
The proposal claims the team shipped Daedalus 8.0 and 11.0 during the IOG contract period and that Daedalus 11.0 was the first wallet capable of crossing the node 11.0 hard fork.
The requested 1,785,333 ADA budget is allocated as 1,666,667 ADA for labor, 33,333 ADA for test hardware, 33,333 ADA for financial audit, and 52,000 ADA for the Intersect administration fee.
The proposer states any unspent labor, hardware, or audit budget at contract close will be returned to the treasury.

The proposal says compatible releases will be available at least 2 weeks before each mainnet hard fork, official releases will be cryptographically signed, and release-timing and version-currency metrics are independently verifiable from public GitHub repositories and the Cardano mainnet chain.
The proposal claims it does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission and links to the relevant governance action.
The proposer states Se7en Labs has not received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months and that its Daedalus work has been under a direct IOG contract closing August 31, 2026.

Intersect is described as administrator and independent milestone verifier, with monthly disbursement against verified work, dedicated auditable accounts, smart-contract tooling, and external Oversight Committee checks involving Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl.

summary: The proposal requests 1,785,333 ADA for a year of Daedalus full-node wallet maintenance, protocol readiness, hardware wallet and CIP-30 improvements, Japanese localisation, support, audit, and Intersect-administered milestone oversight.
